text: First release. Vendors Radford Neal’s ‘xsum’ (stable version 3), patched standard /O reaches compiled code; upstream’s checker fuzzer run vendored copy CI. vignette, vignette("exact-summation"), explains base sum() differs platforms sum pieces C. xsum() returns exactly rounded sum double, integer, logical complex vectors, na.rm, applying special-value rules every platform. ALTREP vectors read blocks, never materialised. zuexact_info() reports vendored ‘xsum’ version, accumulator threshold, SIMD FMA support, whether R long doubles. xsum_mean() divides exact sum count one rounding; xsum_weighted_mean() divides two exact sums. xsum_dot(), xsum_sqnorm() xsum_norm() include product’s rounding error (TwoProduct fma()), dot products exactly rounded . xsum_cumsum() rounds every prefix sum exactly. Accumulators R values: xsum_acc(), xsum_add(), xsum_merge(), xsum_negate(), xsum_value() xsum_mean_value() build exact sums pieces, order, across processes (serialise). xsum_rowsums(), xsum_colsums() xsum_by() exact versions rowSums(), colSums() rowsum(). Row sums work block rows time, extra memory grow number rows. registered C interface, zuexact_api_v1 inst/include/zuexact.h, gives packages’ C code exact accumulators, sums, dot products, merges means, LinkingTo: zuexact. Every result tested exact rational arithmetic (‘gmp’), PreciseSums::fsum(), test262 Math.sumPrecise vectors ill-conditioned inputs condition number 1e40, must bit-identical every CI platform.
